book.title: NHALU GHWA MAHA PAGHUTYEKITWE NA LUKASI

content: Yesu na Sakayo
Yesu kakiyingila kunkitami kya Yeliko, naywo kakipita pakati ya kitami akyo.
Mukitami akyo, pakibhegha mundu yumu lihina lyake Sakayo. Mundu aywo kakibhegha nkulu ghwa asumula sumu, kangi kakibhegha yuna utopelo.
Mwene kakipalaha kammone Yesu mundu ghwa kya bhuli. Peni yakya lumati lukulu lwa bhandu kakilepelwa kiyaha kakibhegha nhupitaho.
Hinu kakilongoha kuulongolo ghwa lula lumati lwa bhandu kakihubhuka munkongo ghwa nkuyu ngati ammone Yesu, kiyaha nge kakinde mu njila yila.
Yesu pakahikite pahi ya ghula nkongo ghwa nkuyu, kakilolekeha kunani, na kakinng'ombela, “Sakayo ghuhuluke kya kuyumbatika, kiyaha lelo ndahwelekeha ku lubhagha lwako!”
Ndo Sakayo kakihuluka kya kuyumbatika, na kakinkingama Yesu mu lubhagha lwake kya uyelelo nkulu.
Bhandu bhoha bhaabhonite bhakiyanda kuhyongoloka paakilongela, “Kaghenda kubhegha nhenja ghwa mundu yunaulemwa.”

Peni Sakayo kakiyima na kung'ombela Yesu, “Muyihwe, Bambo! Nenga ndaapegha lihinda lya utopelo ghwangu akapukwa, na handa nikighupoka utopelo ghwa mundu kwa makakala nda mmuyihila pancheche ya utopelo ghula.”
Ndo Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Lelo, ulopoho ghukihika mu lubhagha alu, kiyaha ayu naywo ndi kibheleko kya Abulahamu.
Kiyaha Mwana ghwa Mundu kahika kupalaha na kulopoha bhandu bhahobhite.”
Ndambulo ya andumindumi mbinda mabhoko yimo
Bhandu bhaannyihwite Yesu bhakihwacha kukita Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga ghunguhika masaa ghala ghala na akibhegha ugheghela na Yelusalemu ndo Yesu kakilongela ndambulo ayi.
“Pakibhegha mundu yumo ywa lukolo ghwa ghubhutwa, kakibhegha mu mwanja kughenda ku nnima ghwa kutali ngati kakakingame ulongohi ghwa ghubhutwa, mbole kakabhuye.
Kukali na kubhuka kakiakema mbinda libhoko yimo muabhandwa bhake na kakiapegha kila yumo kimati kya ngalabha pakilongela, ‘Makatende kyohele na mbiya aywo mbaka pambala kubhuya.’
Peni bhandu bha nnima ghwake bhakibha paakinnyaghabhalila ndo bhakialaghila ajumbe paakilongela, ‘Tungupala ng'obhe aywo kabhe mutwa ghwetu.’ ”
“Hata naha mundu aywo kakikamuhwa ghubhutwa na kakibhuya ku nnima ghwake. Mbole kakiakema bhala ndumindumi bhake ghwakaalekilite ngalabha ngati kakamanye kya amokolite kwa ndendelo hya kila yumoo.
Nndumitumi ghwa ulongohi kakihika pakilongela, ‘Bambo, kuhumila mukimati kimo ya ngalabha yighunekilite niyimokola mala mbinda mabhoko yimo.’
Yula Nkulu kakinnyanga, ‘Ghutenda maha nbhandwa ghwa maha, kiyaha ghuhyubhalika mumihalo midokwa, ndakupegha makakala mu hitami mbinda mabhoko yimo.’
Ndumindumi ghwa ubhili naywo kakihika, pakilongela, ‘Bambo, mukimati kya ngalabha kighungamuhite kiyonnjokeheka mala nhano.’
Bambo ghwake kakinnyanga, ‘Na ghwenga ghwa bhegha nkulu muhitami nhano.’
Mbole kakihika yula nbhandwa yungi pakilongela, ‘Bambo ghutole kimati kya ngalabha hyako. Kiyaha nikiyihiha maha mulipinda.
Nikiyoghopa kiyaha ghwenga ndo mundu nhakata. Ghwenga ghungutola hilibhi hibheghite hyako ng'obhe, na kunuka hila ghuyihimelihite ng'obhe.’
Bambo ghwake kakinnyanga, ‘Ningughutosa kwa kya lilagho lyako, ghwenga nbhandwa nhakata, ghukimanya kukita nenga nhakata yunakutola hilibhi hiibheghite hyangu ng'obhe na kunuka kyanga kuhimeleha,
kiyaha niki, ghukihibhika ng'obhe kimati kya ngalabha yangu kwa ayahika ngalabha ngati pamuya ntole yiibheghite yangu na yila yiiyonjokihite?’
Ndo kakiaghombela bhala bhaayimite ugheghela, ‘Mumpoke kimati kya ngalabha yake na makanpeghe yula ywakabheghite na himati mbinda mabhoko yimo.’
Bhakinng'ombela, ‘Bambo, aywo kabhegha kala na himati hya ngalabha mbinda mabhoko yimo!’
Kakiayanga, ‘Ninguaghombela kukita, ywohele ywakabheghite na kilibhi, katayonjokehwa, na yula ywa nga kilibhi, hata kila kyakabheghite nakyo, katapokwa,
peni bhala amyanja bhangu bhene bha nga kupala mmeghe mutwa ghwabhe, maayeghe apa makaakome kunu nenga pannola.’ ”
Yesu kanguyingila ku Yelusalemu kwa Chekwa
Mbole ya kughalongela agha Yesu kakilongola kughenda ku Yelusalemu.
Naywo pakaheghelelite kuhika muhijiji hya Betifage na Betania ugheghele na kitumbi kiikemitwe kitumbi kya mikongo ya miseituni, kakialaghila ahundwa bhake abhili,

pakialongela, “Nng'endi mu kijiji kila kibheghite mu ulongolo ghwenu, pammegha mu kuyingila mu kijiji akyo, maamona mwana kaputa lyana lyanga kuhubhukwa na mundu ywohele, kabhopwa apwo. Munhughule na munnyeghele apa.
Handa mundu kataakonya, ‘Bhuli mungunhughula?’ Munng'ombele, ‘Bambo kangunnyupa.’ ”
Bhala bha alaghilitwe bhakighenda, na bhakibhona hyoha hila hila handa bhula pakaaghombilitwe na Yesu.
Paabheghite mukunhughula lila kaputa lyana, yula bambo ywakalihughite lila kaputa kakiakonya, “Bhuli mungunhughula alyo kaputa lyana?”
Bhala ahundwa bhakiayanga, “Bambo kangunpala.”
Bhakinnyegha kwa Yesu lilala kaputa lyana, na mbole ya kuyalika maha mapinda ghabhe munng'ongo ghwa mwana kaputa bhakinhubhuha Yesu mu nng'ongo ghwa mwana kaputa aywo.
Yesu kakighendelela na mwanja ghwake na bhandu bhakiyalila mapinda ghabhe mu njila.

Pakabheghite ugheghela na Yelusalemu, muuhelelo ghwa kitumbi kya Mikongo ya Miseituni, lumati lwa lahundwa bhake luuntughilite bhakiyanda kuntika Chapanga kwa nnyelelo na kwa lilobhe likulu kwakya ndendelo ya mihabho bhaayibhonite.
Paakilongela, “Kanonelwa Mutwa yunakuhika kwa lihina lya Bambo Chapanga! Uhihimilo kunani kwa Chapanga na ukulu akwo kunani munu.”
Amoo bha Akaafalisayo bha abheghite mulula lumati lwa bhandu bhakinng'ombela Yesu, “Nhunda ghubhalakalile ahundwa bhako anyamale.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Nunguaghombela, handa abha bhaanyamala, maganga agha ghaachobha kyobho.”
Yesu kangualilila bhandu bha kitami kya Yelusalemu
Yesu pakabheghite ugheghela na kitami kya ku Yelusalemu na pakakibhonite kitami, kakikililila,
pakilongela kwa kya bhandu bha kitami akyo, “Nikipalaha hata lelo mmanyi mihalo ya kutenda ngati mmeghe na uhihimililo, peni hinu ghuihihwa na mahotola ng'obhe kughubhona uhihimilo.
Kulyaghila manjubha ghaahika, na amyanja bhako bhaakuchengela kindupa kikangamalo kukitindila kitami kyako nabho bhaayanda kukututa kuhuma mumbande hyoha.
Bhatakubajanga ghwenga na bhana bhako mu hindupa hyako. Nabho bhataleka ng'obhe liganga limu kunani ya liganga lingi, kiyaha ghukilimanya ng'obhe lisaa lyakahikite Chapanga kukulopoha.”
Yesu kangughenda ku Kitutubhi kya Chapanga
Mbole Yesu kakiyingila mulubhigho lwa kitutubhi kya Chapanga, na kakiyanda kuabhingabhinga bhala bhaabheghite mu kuhemengana hilibhi amwo.
Naywo kakiaghombela, “Yikityekwa mumalembo gha Chapanga, Chapanga kakilongela, ‘Kitutubhi kya nenga Chapanga kyaabhegha kitutubhi kya nnyupo.’ Peni mwenga mungukitenda kibhe mbako ya apoka.”
Mumanjubha ghoha Yesu kakibhegha pakihunda Pakitutubhi kya Chapanga. Peni andundame akulu na ahunda bha malaghilo na hilongohi bha bhandu bhakibhegha paakipalaha njila ngati ankome.
Peni akihotola ng'obhe kiyaha bhandu bhoha bhakibhegha paakinnyihwa kya nga kutagha lilagho limo.
